purpose: Fixed official upstream integration plus all retained Fork regressions; production held
skip_policy: Off-host platforms markers are not coverage; the matching Linux/Windows/macOS job must execute each host-specific case.
Windows file-symlink privilege skip requires the corresponding symlink test to pass on Linux; no UAC bypass.
Any other skip requires explicit review; skipped tests are never counted as executed success.
Windows installer acceptance uses strict_acceptance=1, requires crash-cell evidence, and may not be replaced by unit tests.
